policy_presence.summary: Official generative AI guidance and scope boundaries for Uppsala University are retained in local candidate evidence pending independent presentation review.

ai_disclosure.summary: Courses must specify in writing whether and how AI use must be reported.

coursework.summary: Course examiners may set justified restrictions. The Law Faculty has narrower assessment rules.

exams.summary: Check instructions before using AI in an examination; Law faculty restrictions apply to assessment.

privacy_data_entry.summary: Sensitive personal data require an approved system; student material cannot be sent to potential training systems without consent.

academic_integrity.summary: Suspected deception has investigation, response, hearing and appeal stages; no automatic fixed AI penalty.

approved_tools.summary: Uppsala students have free institutional browser Copilot access, not blanket assessment permission.

named_ai_services.summary: Named AI services for Uppsala University are retained as discovery records pending independent presentation review; service availability does not grant assessment permission.

teaching_guidance.summary: Teaching guidance asks staff to check AI output; uploading identifiable student content and machine grading require further scrutiny.

research_guidance.summary: Research practical guidance recommends documenting use and checking outputs; it is not a binding research publication policy.

security_procurement.summary: Research tool procurement is directed to IT support for licence and security assessment; institution-wide procurement rule not verified.
